era: PS2 / PSP / PS3 / PS Vita / PS4 shooter
summary: Guerrilla's PlayStation-exclusive sci-fi shooter series, covering the PS2 original, PSP/Vita side entries, PS3 sequels, Shadow Fall, and the PS3 trilogy package.

entries.title: Killzone

primary.why: The PS2 original was remastered by Supermassive Games for PS3 as part of Killzone Trilogy and as a standalone PSN release, making PS3 the best fidelity route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS3 remaster through RPCS3 or original PS3 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Use PS2 original only for original-hardware comparison.

entries.title: Killzone: Liberation

primary.why: The 2023 PS4/PS5 release adds up-rendering, rewind, quick save, filters, trophies, and includes the previously released DLC.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4/PS5 PlayStation Store release; use PPSSPP only for original PSP comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original online/multiplayer context differs from current release.

entries.title: Killzone 2

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Killzone 2 is a PS3-only main entry with no modern remaster documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or original PS3 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original online multiplayer era is no longer equivalent to current play.

entries.title: Killzone 3

emulation.notes: Use PS3 hardware if emulation is not stable.

primary.why: Killzone 3 is a PS3-only main entry with no later remaster documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play through RPCS3 if compatible or original PS3 hardware.

entries.remaster_caveats: 3D/Move support is part of the PS3-era feature context.

entries.title: Killzone Trilogy

primary.why: Killzone Trilogy bundles the PS3 remaster of Killzone with Killzone 2 and Killzone 3, making it the best packaged route for the original home-console trilogy.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PS3 hardware or through RPCS3 if compatible.

entries.remaster_caveats: Does not include Liberation, Mercenary, or Shadow Fall.

primary.why: Mercenary is a Vita-only installment and the first Killzone game not developed by Guerrilla Games; it has no modern port documented.
primary.how_to_play: Play on PlayStation Vita hardware; online servers were shut down on August 12, 2022.

entries.title: Killzone Shadow Fall

primary.why: Shadow Fall is the PS4 launch entry and the latest mainline Killzone release; PS5 backward compatibility is the current route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 release on PS5 compatibility or PS4 hardware; online servers were shut down on August 12, 2022.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC or remastered release documented.

entries.title: Killzone Shadow Fall Intercept

emulation.notes: Use PS4/PS5 compatibility if accessible; server status is the limiting factor.

primary.why: Intercept added a four-player co-op mode to Shadow Fall and later received a standalone release on PS4.
primary.how_to_play: Archive as Shadow Fall co-op content; online server shutdown limits normal current play.

entries.remaster_caveats: Treat as online co-op content tied to Shadow Fall rather than a full campaign sequel.
